content: RAI ('Flexible Agent Framework for Embodied AI', RobotecAI, arXiv:2505.07532) is a vendor-agnostic, Apache-2.0 agentic framework layering LLM/VLM tool-calling over ROS2. Core abstractions: Agent, Connector (pub/sub + service + action), Tool (LangChain-compatible). Ships whoami (embodiment identity from URDF/docs), multi-agent + multimodal HRI support, and demo integrations (Nav2 navigation + open-set detection for a mobile robot agent, Franka Panda manipulation, agricultural robot). Source: arxiv.org/abs/2505.07532, github.com/RobotecAI/rai.
